inShort: A and B dink backhand to backhand from the left side and try to pull each other wide. Points to 5.
rules: A and B both stand on the left half of their kitchen line, so the cross-court dink is a backhand for both (for right-handers).
Dink cross-court and try to pull the other player wide.
Pulled wide, with a foot past the sideline? Play the next ball to the middle, not back cross-court.
You win a point when the other player pops the ball up or hits it into the net or out.
Shuffle to every ball and meet it out in front of the knee on your non-paddle side.
Play to 5, then start the next game.
tooEasy: Play one game with slice only, one with topspin only, then mix.
tooHard: Play without points and think only about the shuffle step and meeting the ball out in front.
goodLooksLike: The feet keep moving, contact is out in front, and the ball stays low even when you are pulled wide.

drill.title: Backhand Cross-Court Rally Game (Oddside Mirror Drill)
